        /// <summary>
        /// Gets an array of long integers by name.
        /// </summary>
        // vpkstuff patch: unchecked UInt64 -> long conversion, mirroring
        // GetUnsignedIntegerArray's unchecked Int32 handling above. Community-compiled
        // models store m_refMeshGroupMasks as UInt64 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF ("member of all
        // groups"); the checked Convert.ChangeType path in GetArray<long> throws
        // OverflowException there, which cost 32 library models their whole mesh-group
        // read (variant schema, variant bake, glTF variant export). Bit semantics are
        // what every caller wants: 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF becomes -1L (all bits set).
        public static long[] GetIntegerArray(this KVObject obj, string name)
        {
            if (!obj.TryGetValue(name, out var child) || !child.IsArray)
            {
                return [];
            }

            var span = child.AsArraySpan();
            var result = new long[span.Length];

            for (var i = 0; i < span.Length; i++)
            {
                var elem = span[i];

                if (elem.ValueType is KVValueType.Null or KVValueType.Collection or KVValueType.Array)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (elem.ValueType == KVValueType.UInt64)
                {
                    unchecked
                    {
                        result[i] = (long)(ulong)elem;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    result[i] = (long)elem;
                }
            }

            return result;
        }
